本声明适用于 SwiftRust iOS 客户端，更新日期为 2026-11-2: This policy covers the SwiftRust iOS app, a client for remote devices you are authorized to access. Updated November 21, 2026.
SwiftRust 开发者不运营用于接收应用用户数据的后台服务。应用不会自动向开: SwiftRust has no developer-operated server for collecting app user data. It does not automatically send remote screens, files, passwords, clipboard contents, connection history or usage records to the developer. There are no ads, behavioral analytics or automatic crash reports sent to the developer.
客户端联网不等于向开发者收集数据。应用运行和使用连接功能时，会与远程设备、默认或: Remote access requires network communication. SwiftRust exchanges connection details with your remote devices, default or custom ID, relay and API servers, and any proxies you enable. This may include device IDs, addresses, ports, authentication details and network metadata. Session traffic includes screens, audio, input, files and, when enabled, clipboard contents. This traffic is not sent to a developer-operated collection server.
这些服务可能按其配置和隐私政策处理、记录或保存数据。请自行确认远程设备的访问权限: Service providers may process or retain data under their own settings and privacy policies. Use only devices you may access and providers you trust. You can choose self-hosted servers, disable proxies or turn off session features. The developer does not receive these providers’ backend records and cannot access or delete records on their behalf.
连接历史、收藏、设备别名、界面偏好、自定义快捷键、翻译缓存和下载文件保存在设备上: Connection history, favorites, device names, preferences, shortcuts, cached translations and downloads stay in the app’s local storage. Uploads may create temporary copies. Local diagnostic logs may contain device addresses, connection times and errors. These contents are not automatically sent to the developer.
登录你使用的 API 服务时，凭据和验证码会发送给该服务；登录状态及访问令牌保存: Signing in sends credentials and verification codes to the API service you use. Sign-in state and access tokens stay on your device. The connection core stores saved remote passwords. Proxy drafts and credentials are kept in the device Keychain; the connection core also manages the active proxy settings.
仅在启用后运行内嵌 Tailscale 节点，不建立系统 VPN，也不接管其他应: The embedded Tailscale node runs only when you enable it. It does not create a system VPN or route traffic from other apps. Browser authorization and Auth key sign-in contact Tailscale, which may process account details, node names, addresses, public keys and connection metadata. SDK log uploads are disabled; Tailscale may still keep records needed to provide its service.
Auth key 不写入普通设置、钥匙串或应用日志。节点身份状态保存在应用私有目: Auth keys are not written to app preferences, Keychain or app logs. Node identity is stored in the app’s private directory and excluded from system backups. Signing out of Tailscale clears local node state. Contact Tailscale or your tailnet administrator to manage or request deletion of server-side device records, logs and account data.
苹果 Translation 框架仅接收固定界面文案，用于补全缺失译文，不接收远: Apple’s Translation framework is used only to translate fixed interface text. It is not given remote screens, hostnames, passwords, input, files or clipboard contents. Translations are cached locally, and iOS may download language packs. Apple services, system diagnostics and backups follow your system settings and Apple’s privacy policy.
赞助通过 Apple App 内购买处理。Apple 负责付款、交易记录及退款；: Apple processes tips through In-App Purchase and handles payment records and refunds. SwiftRust verifies and completes transactions on your device. It does not see your payment card details or send transactions to a developer-operated purchase database. TestFlight purchases are sandbox tests and do not charge you.
仅在打开扫码连接时请求相机权限，用于识别连接二维码，不保存或上传相机画面到开发者: Camera access is requested only when you open the QR scanner. Camera images are used to read connection codes, not saved or uploaded to the developer. File import accesses only items you authorize in the system picker. You can revoke permissions in iOS Settings. Manual remote ID entry works without camera access.
开发者没有应用后台的用户账号、会话内容或文件数据库，因此没有可由开发者查询或执行: SwiftRust does not create developer-hosted user accounts. The developer has no backend database of your accounts, session contents or files to retrieve or delete. Signing in to an external service creates no account with the SwiftRust developer.
本机数据会保留至你删除相关记录或文件、清除对应配置或移除应用。可在设备菜单删除连: Local data remains until you delete it, clear its settings or remove the app. Delete connection history and saved passwords from device menus, and local files from Downloads. To clear proxy credentials, disable the proxy, clear the address and authentication fields, then save. Removing the app may leave Keychain items, backups, exported files and remote data intact.
停止连接、关闭 Tailscale 或代理、退出账号或撤销系统权限可停止相关功能: You can stop connections, disable Tailscale or proxies, sign out, or revoke system permissions to stop the related features. Ask the relevant provider or administrator about server-side retention, account deletion and other data rights. Their policies and applicable law govern those requests. Clearing local data or signing out does not automatically delete server-side records.
仅当你主动发送邮件或提供资料时，开发者会收到你的邮箱地址、邮件内容及你选择附上的: If you choose to email the developer, the developer receives your email address, message and any files or logs you attach to respond and investigate the issue. SwiftRust does not send feedback or attach logs automatically. Please leave out passwords, Auth keys and private information that is not needed.
反馈资料仅用于处理沟通和问题。你可以通过下方邮箱请求删除开发者持有的反馈资料；法: Feedback is used only to respond and resolve issues. Contact the address below to request deletion of feedback held by the developer, except where retention is required by law. GitHub and X links open only when you select them. Those platforms handle account and access data under their own policies.
触控板与新直接触控：双指上下浏览、三指左右浏览。原版鼠标与直接触控：双指移动画布: Trackpad and New Direct Touch: scroll vertically with two fingers and horizontally with three. Original Mouse and Direct Touch: pan with two fingers and scroll vertically with three.
发生了什么，或者你希望增加什么功能？: What happened, or what would you like to see?

本声明适用于 SwiftRust iOS 客户端，更新日期为 2026-11-2: This statement applies to the SwiftRust iOS client, updated November 22, 2026. SwiftRust connects to remote devices you are authorized to access.
在「设置 → 关于 → 发送反馈」中，仅在你点击发送后，AirFeedback: In Settings → About → Send Feedback, AirFeedback receives your message, up to four images you select, app version and build, device model, OS version and locale only after you tap Send. The form requires no account or email and attaches no connection logs. Do not submit passwords, Auth keys or unnecessary personal information; review screenshots before sending.
应用启动时会启用 Apple MetricKit。系统通常在后续启动时交付崩溃诊: Apple MetricKit is enabled at launch. The system usually delivers crash diagnostics on a later launch. AirFeedback receives the crash time, app version and build and bundle ID, device model, OS version and build, architecture, locale, exception type and message, termination reason and thread stacks. Reports contain a random per-install identifier only to count affected installations, not an account, remote files or memory contents; exception messages may still contain error context.
未发送成功的崩溃报告最多在本机排队 20 份，在后续启动时重试。应用使用 App: Up to 20 unsent crash reports are queued locally for retry on later launches. The app attempts to use App Attest to verify reports came from a genuine build; when supported and configured, verification proofs are exchanged with Apple and AirFeedback. Reports can still be submitted without verification. Feedback and crash reports are not used for behavioral analytics.
SwiftRust 使用 AirFeedback 接收你主动提交的反馈及自动崩溃: SwiftRust uses AirFeedback for feedback you submit and automatic crash reports, for app functionality and troubleshooting, and AirTraffic for anonymous usage analytics. There are no ads. Remote screens, files, passwords, clipboard contents and connection history are not automatically uploaded to the developer.
SwiftRust 不创建开发者托管的用户账号，也不在开发者后台保存远程会话内容: SwiftRust does not create developer-hosted user accounts or store remote session content or a file database on the developer’s server. Signing into a third-party service does not register an account with the developer. AirFeedback feedback and crash reports and AirTraffic anonymous analytics are retained as needed for support and analytics; no fixed automatic deletion period is promised. Contact the email below for access or deletion requests. Anonymous analytics are not linked to accounts, so an account alone may not locate the corresponding records.
反馈及崩溃资料仅用于应用功能、沟通和问题排查，不用于广告、追踪或关联你的账号。资: Feedback and crash data are used only for app functionality, communication and troubleshooting, not advertising, tracking or linking to your account. Data is retained as needed for support; resolving an issue does not guarantee automatic deletion. You can request deletion of developer-held data at the email below, except where retention is legally required. If you send email, the developer also receives your email address, message and attachments. GitHub and X links open only when selected; their own policies govern accounts and access data.
仅统计主页、收藏、设置页面访问和应用启动等活动，不关联账号，不收集远程 ID、输: Counts only Home, Favorites and Settings views and app lifecycle activity. Not linked to accounts; no remote IDs, input, files or session content. Turning this off stops future analytics, not feedback or crash reports.
AirTraffic 仅接收主页、收藏、设置的固定页面名称及安装、更新、打开、进: AirTraffic receives only fixed Home, Favorites and Settings screen names and app install, update, open and background activity. Analytics include a random per-install identifier, session identifier, timestamps, app version and build, OS version, device model and simulator or TestFlight status. No advertising identifier, account linking, person profiles or cross-app tracking is used. IP geolocation enrichment is requested off.
统计不接收远程 ID、主机名、账号、密码、输入、搜索词、文件名、错误消息、反馈内: Analytics do not receive remote IDs, hostnames, accounts, passwords, input, searches, file names, error messages, feedback or remote session content. Click/text autocapture, session replay, surveys, feature flags and analytics SDK crash capture are disabled. Turn off future analytics in Settings → Privacy → Anonymous Usage Analytics. This does not affect AirFeedback feedback or automatic crash reports, or automatically delete data already received. Removing or reinstalling the app may reset the analytics identifier.

账号不是直接连接设备的必要条件。请仅连接你有权访问的设备，并根据需要关闭剪贴板、: An account is not required for direct device connections. Connect only to devices you are authorized to access. Disable clipboard, audio, or file transfer, or enable View-Only Mode as needed.

Signing out does not delete the server account or its records.
